description: Contract for the Fergents kernel JSON-RPC 2.0 protocol over the local socket. Source of truth for Rust and TypeScript codegen.

Event.title: Event
Event.description: A kernel event emitted on the bus (ARCHITECTURE.md §4.2).

source.description: Who emitted the event, e.g. agent:ferg-01.

correlation_id.description: Groups events in one logical operation.

HelloParams.title: HelloParams
HelloParams.description: First command sent by a client after connecting.

WelcomeResult.title: WelcomeResult
WelcomeResult.description: Kernel reply to hello when the client version is compatible.

PingResult.title: PingResult
PingResult.description: Liveness probe reply; carries no diagnostics.

topics.description: Topic prefixes, e.g. kernel. or file.changed.

from_id.description: Deliver events strictly after this id.

BrainListParams.title: BrainListParams
BrainListParams.description: Params of brain.list. `brain.list` is extended in Phase 1 with an archived filter.

BrainRole.title: BrainRole
BrainRole.description: A brain's role within a project (BRAIN.md §8.1).

template.description: Template name, e.g. blank, personal, research, coding, team (BRAIN.md §7.1).

path.description: Filesystem path for the new brain.

BrainGetResult.title: BrainGetResult
BrainGetResult.description: Result of brain.get: the brain summary, its lifecycle state, and its brain.toml config (BRAIN.md §6.1).

BrainUpdateParams.title: BrainUpdateParams
BrainUpdateParams.description: Params of brain.update: mutable identity fields (BRAIN.md §6.1 [brain]).

rewrite_links.description: Rewrite internal links to the new brain id (BRAIN.md §8.5).

BrainMoveParams.title: BrainMoveParams
BrainMoveParams.description: Params of brain.move: relocate a brain folder (BRAIN.md §10.1).

confirm_name.description: The brain name, typed to confirm deletion (BRAIN.md §9.6).

permanent.description: Delete permanently instead of moving to trash (BRAIN.md §9.6).

output.description: Path of the .fergbrain archive to write.

include_index.description: Include index.sqlite and graph.db (excluded by default; BRAIN.md §14.1).

path.description: Path of the .fergbrain archive to import.

target_path.description: Filesystem path to extract the brain into.

full.description: Force a full reindex instead of an incremental one.

exclude_private.description: Exclude personal data from the template (BRAIN.md §7.2).

SyncConfig.title: SyncConfig
SyncConfig.description: The [sync] section of brain.toml. Parsed and preserved only in Phase 1 (no runtime effect).

GitConfig.title: GitConfig
GitConfig.description: The [git] section of brain.toml. Parsed and preserved only in Phase 1 (no runtime effect).

Document.title: Document
Document.description: A row of the documents table (spec Appendix B).

frontmatter.description: Raw YAML frontmatter as JSON (single source of truth).

deleted_at.description: Set when the document is soft-deleted.

NoteRef.title: NoteRef
NoteRef.description: A lightweight reference to a note.

LinkRef.title: LinkRef
LinkRef.description: A row of the links table (spec Appendix B).

unresolved.description: True when the target does not exist yet.

OutlineEntry.title: OutlineEntry
OutlineEntry.description: A heading in a note's outline, in document order (BRAIN.md §4.2). The tree is derived from `level`.

UnlinkedMention.title: UnlinkedMention
UnlinkedMention.description: A place where a note's title appears as plain text, not a link (GRAPH.md §7.3).

Tag.title: Tag
Tag.description: A row of the tags table (spec Appendix B).

IndexStatusResult.title: IndexStatusResult
IndexStatusResult.description: Index status: the persisted, observable job queue (SEARCH.md §13.2, §13.4; spec Appendix B index_jobs).

queued.description: Jobs waiting in the persisted queue.

attempts.description: Total retry attempts across queued/running jobs (index_jobs.attempts).

path.description: Vault-relative path of the new note.

DocDeleteParams.title: DocDeleteParams
DocDeleteParams.description: Params of doc.delete (soft delete; spec Task 8.4).

DocOutlineResult.title: DocOutlineResult
DocOutlineResult.description: The heading outline of a note, in document order (levels imply nesting).

LinksBrokenResult.title: LinksBrokenResult
LinksBrokenResult.description: Links whose target is unresolved (spec Appendix B, links.unresolved).

DailyOpenResult.title: DailyOpenResult
DailyOpenResult.description: The daily note, created on first open of the day (BRAIN.md §4.4).

created.description: True when the note was created by this call.

TemplateRenderParams.title: TemplateRenderParams
TemplateRenderParams.description: Params of template.render. Variables from BRAIN.md §4.5 (date/time/datetime are computed; title/selection/clipboard are provided).

cursor.description: Byte offset of the {{cursor}} placeholder in content, if present.

language.description: Query language; the doc example uses datalog.

GraphQueryResult.title: GraphQueryResult
GraphQueryResult.description: Rows returned by a graph query (columns depend on the query).

GraphAlgoParams.title: GraphAlgoParams
GraphAlgoParams.description: Params of graph.algo (GRAPH.md §10.3). Algorithms: shortest_path, neighbors, centrality, pagerank, communities, similarity, cycles, subgraph (§10.1).

GraphAlgoResult.title: GraphAlgoResult
GraphAlgoResult.description: Rows returned by a graph algorithm (shape depends on the algorithm).

target_id.description: Canonical entity kept after the merge.

IndexJobOp.title: IndexJobOp
IndexJobOp.description: Index job operation (spec Appendix B, index_jobs.op).

IndexQueuedPayload.title: IndexQueuedPayload
IndexQueuedPayload.description: Payload of the index.queued event (spec Appendix B, index_jobs).

CapabilityView.title: CapabilityView
CapabilityView.description: A capability as reported by capability.list / capability.get (spec Appendix D).

auto_enable_deps.description: Enable disabled dependencies instead of failing.

AgentLoopKind.title: AgentLoopKind
AgentLoopKind.description: The loop pattern an agent uses (AGENTS.md §5.3).

AgentMemoryConfig.title: AgentMemoryConfig
AgentMemoryConfig.description: Memory settings of an agent definition (AGENTS.md §8).

AgentSubAgentsConfig.title: AgentSubAgentsConfig
AgentSubAgentsConfig.description: Sub-agent settings of an agent definition (AGENTS.md §9).

AgentDefinition.title: AgentDefinition
AgentDefinition.description: A parsed agents/<id>.md definition (AGENTS.md §4). The Markdown body is the system prompt and is not part of this payload.

AgentCreateParams.title: AgentCreateParams
AgentCreateParams.description: Params of agent.create: the full Markdown definition.

definition.description: YAML frontmatter followed by the Markdown system prompt.

SecretRef.title: SecretRef
SecretRef.description: A secret reference (secret_refs row). Values never leave the keychain.

SecretListResult.title: SecretListResult
SecretListResult.description: Result of secret.list (names and metadata only).

SecretSetParams.title: SecretSetParams
SecretSetParams.description: Params of secret.set: write the value to the OS keychain.

SecretNameParams.title: SecretNameParams
SecretNameParams.description: Params carrying a secret name (secret.delete, secret.test).

SecretTestResult.title: SecretTestResult
SecretTestResult.description: Result of secret.test: presence only, never the value.

ProviderConfig.title: ProviderConfig
ProviderConfig.description: A configured LLM provider. API keys live in the keychain, referenced by secret_name.

ProviderAddParams.title: ProviderAddParams
ProviderAddParams.description: Params of provider.add: configure or replace a provider.

ProviderIdParams.title: ProviderIdParams
ProviderIdParams.description: Params carrying a provider id (provider.remove, provider.test, provider.models).

ProviderRoute.title: ProviderRoute
ProviderRoute.description: An ordered model chain for a task.

McpServer.title: McpServer
McpServer.description: A configured MCP server and its live connection state.

McpServerAddParams.title: McpServerAddParams
McpServerAddParams.description: Params of mcp.server.add: configure or replace a server.

McpServerIdParams.title: McpServerIdParams
McpServerIdParams.description: Params carrying an MCP server id (remove, test, health).

McpTool.title: McpTool
McpTool.description: A tool discovered from a connected MCP server.

ChatCompareSide.title: ChatCompareSide
ChatCompareSide.description: One side of a compare run: its session, model, and reply.

ChatCompareStartParams.title: ChatCompareStartParams
ChatCompareStartParams.description: Params of chat.compare.start: one prompt, several models (decision D9).

AgentSpawnParams.title: AgentSpawnParams
AgentSpawnParams.description: Params of agent.spawn: run a child agent in the background.

AgentChildrenParams.title: AgentChildrenParams
AgentChildrenParams.description: Params of agent.children: list tracked sub-agents.

AgentSessionParams.title: AgentSessionParams
AgentSessionParams.description: Params of agent.collect / agent.cancel: one sub-agent session.

AgentMessageParams.title: AgentMessageParams
AgentMessageParams.description: Params of agent.message: append a message to a session.

AgentHandoffParams.title: AgentHandoffParams
AgentHandoffParams.description: Params of agent.handoff: transfer a task to another agent.

AgentUpdateParams.title: AgentUpdateParams
AgentUpdateParams.description: Params of agent.update: replace a definition.

AgentUpdateResult.title: AgentUpdateResult
AgentUpdateResult.description: Result of agent.update: the stored definition.

AgentRunResult.title: AgentRunResult
AgentRunResult.description: Result of agent.run: the run outcome (AGENTS.md §5.2).

ContextSection.title: ContextSection
ContextSection.description: One assembled context section (spec §2, Context Viewer).

AutonomyMode.title: AutonomyMode
AutonomyMode.description: How far a spec workflow runs before pausing (decision D7).

artifacts.description: Written artifact paths keyed by gate label.
Artifact Markdown keyed by gate label.

PermissionRequest.title: PermissionRequest
PermissionRequest.description: A tool call awaiting a permission decision.

PermissionCard.title: PermissionCard
PermissionCard.description: The payload the UI renders in a permission card (UI.md §12).

PermissionResolved.title: PermissionResolved
PermissionResolved.description: The outcome of a permission check.

PermissionPolicyRule.title: PermissionPolicyRule
PermissionPolicyRule.description: One ordered permission policy rule (first match wins).

tool_calls.description: Tool calls, when this is an assistant tool-call turn.

ChatSessionIdParams.title: ChatSessionIdParams
ChatSessionIdParams.description: Params carrying a chat session id.

ChatSessionModelParams.title: ChatSessionModelParams
ChatSessionModelParams.description: Params of chat.session.model — pins the model a session runs on.

ChatMessageSendResult.title: ChatMessageSendResult
ChatMessageSendResult.description: Result of chat.message.send: the session transcript after the agent reply.

ChatMessageRetryParams.title: ChatMessageRetryParams
ChatMessageRetryParams.description: Params of chat.message.retry: re-answer the last user turn.

ChatRegenerateResult.title: ChatRegenerateResult
ChatRegenerateResult.description: Result of chat.message.regenerate: the prompt to re-answer.

AttachmentRouting.title: AttachmentRouting
AttachmentRouting.description: How an attachment was routed into the conversation.

TrustState.title: TrustState
TrustState.description: Whether a project may run code (spec decision D3).

Project.title: Project
Project.description: An opened code workspace (spec Appendix B).

FileSnapshot.title: FileSnapshot
FileSnapshot.description: A file read from a project (spec decision D2).

FileEntry.title: FileEntry
FileEntry.description: One entry in a project directory listing.

FilePathParams.title: FilePathParams
FilePathParams.description: Params carrying a project id and a path.

FileStatResult.title: FileStatResult
FileStatResult.description: Result of file.stat, file.mkdir, and file.rename.
